meta_description: Magpie Plumbing provides emergency and routine plumbing repairs across Coventry. Fast response, honest pricing, no call-out charge. Call now for same-day service.
hero_eyebrow: Fast Emergency Response — Local Coventry Plumber
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Coventry? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to planned maintenance, we handle the full range of domestic and light commercial plumbing work.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to resolve most faults within the first visit.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New boiler installation with full warranty, or rapid diagnosis and repair of your existing system. Covering all major brands.

services.title: Central Heating & Radiators
services.desc: System upgrades, radiator replacement, and power flushing to restore efficiency and cut energy bills.

services.title: Bathroom Suites & Tiling
services.desc: Full bathroom design and installation, from suite selection through to tiling and finishing. Completed on time, every time.

services.title: Kitchen Sink & Tap Installation
services.desc: New taps, sinks, and dishwasher plumbing installed to specification, with old fixtures removed and disposed of properly.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Drainage
services.desc: CCTV drain surveys and high-pressure jetting to clear blockages without mess. Repairs to cracked or broken soil pipes.

about_pullquote: I started Magpie because I was tired of seeing customers ripped off by big companies charging premium rates for shoddy work.
about_para_1: Magpie Plumbing was founded in 2012 by a plumber who believed Coventry homeowners deserved honest pricing and workmanship without the corporate markup. Over the past 12 years, we've built our reputation on showing up on time, diagnosing faults clearly, and fixing them right the first time. Our no-nonsense approach has earned us hundreds of repeat customers across the city.
about_para_2: We pride ourselves on keeping costs transparent—no hidden charges, no pressure to replace parts that don't need it. Whether you're dealing with a midnight emergency or planning a bathroom renovation, you get the same level of care and expertise. That's why most of our new work comes through word-of-mouth and customer recommendations.
reviews_heading: What Coventry Homeowners Say About Magpie Plumbing

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on a Sunday morning—absolute nightmare. Called Magpie and they were here in 45 minutes. Fixed it, drained the system, and didn't charge a fortune like some places would. Top bloke, honest and reliable. Will use them again.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Our boiler broke down in winter and I was dreading the bill. The engineer diagnosed a faulty pump valve, quoted a fair price, and fitted a new one the same day. System's been rock solid since. Highly recommend—no sales patter, just proper work.
reviews.author: Lynne P.

reviews.text: Replaced our kitchen taps and sink—they fitted everything cleanly and even made a few suggestions to improve the setup. Good communication, tidy work site, and finished bang on schedule. That's rare these days. Will definitely use them for our bathroom next year.
reviews.author: Robert K.
